notes:
Summary: Veridian is evaluating Redwood Dedicated for a customer-facing AI layer (search + agent). Primary concerns: strict EU data residency, predictable latency, and predictable monthly spend. They asked for a sizing workshop focused on baseline QPS, tokens/sec aggregation, and reserved GPU planning.

Workload profile (from traffic samples): baseline steady-state ~15 QPS, average request size ~512 tokens -> aggregate baseline ~7.7k tokens/sec. Marketing spikes expected 2–3x baseline (peak 40–50 QPS -> ~20–25k tokens/sec). Typical generation path is a mix of short-context reranking requests (~64 tokens) and longer agent responses (~512–1k tokens) depending on user flow. Embeddings ingestion will be batched — non-latency-critical.

SLO / SLA discussion notes: customer requests p50/p95 targets for interactive responses. Suggested starting targets discussed in call: p50 <= 80ms and p95 <= 220ms for 64-token interactive responses at baseline. For 512-token responses target p95 <= 1.2s at baseline. Veridian will want explicit throughput guarantees and a rollback/fallback policy (auto-route to lower-cost models or burst pool) documented in SLA. They asked for RTO/RPO-style language for scheduled maintenance windows.

Preliminary capacity plan (workshop deliverable requested): estimate to cover baseline with headroom — initial sizing: 4x H100-equivalent GPUs for steady baseline (model mix: redwood-13b-quant for chat, mistral-7b variants for smaller rerankers), plus 2x H100 for burst pool to hit 3x peaks with acceptable latency. Quantization and batching assumptions: int8 quant on 13B reduces per-GPU throughput cost ~1.8x; continuous batching expected to improve tokens/sec by ~20% for reranking. SE Markus will produce a "capacity calculator" spreadsheet mapping QPS x avg tokens -> GPU count.

Commercial / negotiation points: Veridian is cost-sensitive but values SLA-backed latency. Expect negotiation on committed monthly GPUs vs burst credits. They requested an enterprise pricing example that binds latency SLOs to credits/penalties. Finance wants ARR estimate for procurement approval; target range discussed: $150k–$450k ARR depending on commit.

Next steps (from call): schedule 2-hr sizing workshop (workshop invite sent for 2026-03-15), run PoC baseline runs (2026-03-10), SE to deliver capacity calc and test-plan by 2026-03-12, legal to send draft data residency addendum.

Quotes: "If we can't guarantee p95 for interactive flows during sales demos, we lose enterprise buyers — we need hard numbers." — Head of Product (Veridian).
